detail.title: CP-UNP-H4521L50-DPQ
detail.overview: 2MP WDR 45x IR Network PTZ Camera- 500 Mtr.
features: AI Instastream, Instastream, H.265, H.264, H.264B, H.264H, MJPEG
Powerful 45x Optical zoom and 16x Digital zoom
WDR(120dB), 2D NR/ 3D NR, Day/Night (ICR), Defog, ROI, AGC, AWB, BLC, HLC
Up to 300 Preset, 5 Auto scan, 8 Tour, 5 Pattern
CMS Software: KVMS Pro Lite, EVMS Pro

General.Minimum Illumination: 0.005 lux@F1.6 (Color, 30 IRE), 0.0005 lux@F1.6 (B/W, 30 IRE), 0 lux@F1.6 (IR on)
General.White Balance: Auto, Indoor, Outdoor, ATW, Manual, Sodium lamp, Natural light, Street lamp
General.Pan/ Tilt Range: Pan: 0° to 360° endless, Tilt: –15° to +90°, auto flip 180°
General.Bit Rate: H.265: 25 kbps–6,400 kbps, H.264: 64 kbps–8,192 kbps
General.Special Features: Up to 300 Presets, 5 Pattern, 8 Tour (up to 32 presets per tour), 5 Auto Scan
General.Privacy Mask: Up to 24 areas can be set, with up to 8 areas in the same view
General.Video Compression: AI Instastream, Instastream, H.265, H.264, H.264B, H.264H, MJPEG
General.Audio Compression: PCM, G.711A, G.711MU, G.726, MPEG2-Layer2, G.722.1, AAC
General.Alarm Event: Motion/ tampering detection, Defocus Detection, Audio detection, SD Card Exception (No  SD card, Low SD card space, SD card error), Network Exception (Offline, IP Conflict), External  Alarm, IMD, Security Warning, AI Events
General.Alarm Linkage: Capture, Recording, Send email, Preset, Tour, Pattern, Alarm digital output
General.Cyber Security: AES 256-bit Encryption, Configuration encryption, trusted execution, Digest, security logs,  WSSE, account lockout, syslog, video encryption, 802.1x, Allow list/Block list, HTTPS, trusted  upgrade, trusted boot, firmware encryption
General.Protocol: SFTP, IPv6, IPv4, DNS,RTCP, NTP, RTP, HTTP, HTTPS, SNMP V3, TLS Version 1.2, TCP/IP, PPPoE,  NFS, UDP, ICMP, SSL, DHCP, SMTP, RTSPS, RTMP, ONVIF (Profile S, Profile G, Profile T), unicast,  multicast, InstaOn
General.IVS (Perimeter Protection): IMD, Crossing Virtual Fence, Tripwire, Intrusion, Abandoned Object, Fast Moving, Parking  Detection, Crowd Gathering, Missing Object, Loitering Detection, Face Detection
General.Tracking Trigger Event: Motion Detection, Defocus Detection, Disk Full, Disk Error, Video Tampering, External Alarm,  Security Warning, Audio Detection, AI Event
General.Certificates: ISO 9001: 2015, ISO 20000-1 : 2018, CE, FCC and RoHS, BIS, STQC approved compliance report
General.Weatherproof Standard: IP67, IK10, TVS 6000 V lightning proof, surge protection, voltage transient protection
